svg.title: Treatment Decision Flowchart - Source Mismatch
svg.desc: Source title says scale removal, but the internal diagram concerns corrosion. Full flow: water analysis → dominant corrosion cause. Dissolved oxygen → oxygen scavenger + passivator. Chloride/H₂S → adsorbing imidazoline + molybdate. Low-temperature acidic water → neutraliser + organic amine. High-temperature alkaline water → dispersing scale inhibitor + zinc salt. Dynamic dosing → corrosion coupons + electrochemical monitoring → corrosion rate ≤0.1 mm/year? Yes: effective; no: adjust blend/dose. Source options are not validated chemical prescriptions.
